note: Not applied to the WeftOS catalog. catalog.json was not edited. Paste only after that catalog's own validator accepts it. Specs are vendor figures from BST-BME680-DS001-09 revision 1.9 (February 2024), not measurements. Hardware not yet tested.

project.name: BME680 environment
project.summary: Bosch BME680 temperature, humidity, pressure and gas resistance over I2C. SenML object readings. Not presence and not an air-quality index.

module.name: Bosch BME680 breakout (purple)
module.summary: BME680 gas, pressure, humidity and temperature sensor on a purple breakout. I2C 0x76 or 0x77. Chip mark BME680.
not_for: IAQ, CO2 or breath-VOC (those are BSEC, not this cog)
5 V power until a regulator is confirmed on this board

spec.interface: I2C 0x76 (SDO low) or 0x77 (SDO high); SPI exists and is not used
spec.quantities: temperature Cel, humidity %RH, pressure Pa, gas resistance Ohm
spec.source: BST-BME680-DS001-09 revision 1.9, February 2024 (vendor, not our measurement)
spec.unconfirmed_on_this_board: regulator versus raw 3.3 V header, silkscreen names, SDO strap, CSB strap

chip.name: BME680
chip.summary: Integrated gas, pressure, humidity and temperature sensor, I2C or SPI.
